name: test_overnight_meeting_in_today[chromium]
description:
An 11:30 PM cross-midnight session must appear in the Today view. (covers TC019 + TC022)

    A meeting seeded at 11:30 PM tonight (60-min, ending 12:30 AM) is created at setup.
    The Today filter must include it because the session starts today.
    Falls back to scanning live 11:xx PM cards if the suite ran after 11:00 PM CDT.
descriptionHtml:
An 11:30 PM cross-midnight session must appear in the Today view. (covers TC019 + TC022)

A meeting seeded at 11:30 PM tonight (60-min, ending 12:30 AM) is created at setup.
The Today filter must include it because the session starts today.
Falls back to scanning live 11:xx PM cards if the suite ran after 11:00 PM CDT.
